title: fix(keyrack): suggest aws sso profile as $awsOrg.$env.$owner and thread owner
description:
## .what

two keyrack aws.sso defects, both patched locally in a consumer via `patches/rhachet.patch`:

1. **suggested profile name takes the slot org, not the aws org.** `setupAwsSsoWithGuide` suggests `$slotOrg.$accountName`. an account of org B set through a slot of org A becomes `a.bnamesquashed` (seen: `ehmpathy.nheuronroot`). the sso portal picker labels each portal by the prefix its profiles share, so org B's portal is then labeled `A`, and two portals read the same label.
2. **owner never reaches the guide.** `vaultAdapterAwsConfig.acquireForSet` drops `context.owner`, and `mechAdapterAwsSso` passes only `org`, so no suggestion can carry env or owner.

## .fix (as patched)

- default suggestion = `$awsOrg.$env.$owner`. aws org = first segment of a multi-segment account name (`nheuron-prep` → `nheuron`), else the slot org. env comes from the key slug, owner from context. empty segments drop out
- thread `owner: context?.owner ?? null` from `acquireForSet` into the mech, and `env` from `keySlug.split('.')`
- clamp cases:
  - `{org:nheuron, env:prep, owner:ehmpath, accountName:nheuron-prep}` → `nheuron.prep.ehmpath`
  - `{org:ehmpathy, env:sudo, owner:ehmpath, accountName:nheuron-root}` → `nheuron.sudo.ehmpath`
  - `{org:ehmpathy, env:prep, owner:ehmpath, accountName:Production}` → `ehmpathy.prep.ehmpath`
  - owner null → `nheuron.prod`

## .also seen

- `keyrack set` rewrites `.agent/keyrack.yml` and strips every comment in it
- the `keyrack.source` sdk input lacks `org?: string` in its `.d.ts`, though `sourceAllKeysIntoEnv` can pass `--org`

## .why

a duplicate portal label sends a human into the wrong aws org at sso pick time. the root fix is the name each profile is born with.
